statement: Qwen3-VL explicitly targets OCR under blur, low light, tilt, rare characters and long-document structure.
actakit_implication: A general multimodal rung may recover content that specialized OCR misses, including unusual handwriting/visual context.

statement: At least the 32B Instruct release is Apache-2.0 and locally runnable through standard model tooling.
actakit_implication: Local multimodal escalation is viable without mandatory cloud egress.

statement: Qwen3-VL is generative and general-purpose rather than an OCR-specific deterministic extractor.
actakit_implication: Constrain prompts/output schemas, keep image/page provenance, and treat output as machine-derived rather than source truth.

statement: General VLM OCR capability is a last automated rung, not evidence that every document should use a VLM.
actakit_implication: Escalate only when cheaper/specialized rungs fail quality policy.
